name: Oil Rip & EM FX: Do BRL, MXN, and ZAR Strengthen When Crude Surges?
description: Event study analyzing BRL, MXN, and ZAR FX performance during crude oil surge events — quarters where WTI crude gains 10%+ (rolling 63-bar return). Uses USDBRL, USDMXN, and USDZAR as primary assets with CL futures and UUP (Dollar Index proxy) as references. Computes inverted FX returns (positive = EM currency strengthened vs USD). Splits oil rip events by DXY regime: weak-USD rips (DXY return ≤ 0) vs strong-USD rips (DXY return > 0). Reports avg FX return, hit rates, cumulative event returns, and regime-split comparisons across all three EM currencies.
source:
# =============================================================================
# OIL RIP & EM FX: DO BRL AND MXN STRENGTHEN WHEN CRUDE SURGES?
# =============================================================================
# Event: WTI crude oil gains 10%+ over a rolling quarter (63 trading days)
# FX convention: USDBRL/USDMXN = USD per unit of EM currency
#   -> Falling pair = EM currency strengthening
#   -> Invert return so positive = EM currency appreciation vs USD
# Output: cs_summary_table, cs_bars, cs_lines with event markers
# =============================================================================

src = market_data_source()()
close_fx = src.c
bar_idx = index()

# =============================================================================
# CRUDE OIL DATA (CL FUTURES via reference_futures + continuation)
# =============================================================================

cl_raw = reference_futures(ticker="CL")()
cl_cont = futures_continuation(
    s_rollover_method=RolloverType.FirstOfMonth,
    s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.BackwardRatio
)(cl_raw.o, cl_raw.h, cl_raw.l, cl_raw.c, cl_raw.v, cl_raw.oi, cl_raw.s)
cl_close = cl_cont.c

# =============================================================================
# DOLLAR INDEX DATA (UUP ETF as DXY proxy)
# =============================================================================

uup_raw = reference_stocks(ticker="UUP")()
uup_close = uup_raw.c

# =============================================================================
# EVENT DETECTION: Oil rip = 10%+ gain over rolling 63-bar quarter
# =============================================================================

oil_q_ret = (cl_close - (cl_close >> 63)) / (cl_close >> 63)

# DXY quarterly return (positive = dollar strengthened)
dxy_q_ret = (uup_close - (uup_close >> 63)) / (uup_close >> 63)

# Detect quarter-start boundaries to sample once per quarter (avoid overlapping)
is_q_start = is_period_boundary(period=PeriodType.quarter, boundary=BoundaryType.start)(bar_idx)

# Oil rip: quarterly oil return >= 10% sampled at quarter boundaries
is_oil_rip = is_q_start and is_valid(oil_q_ret) and (oil_q_ret > 0.10)

# Non-rip quarter starts (for comparison)
is_non_rip = is_q_start and is_valid(oil_q_ret) and (oil_q_ret <= 0.10)

# =============================================================================
# DXY REGIME SPLIT: Weak-USD vs Strong-USD during oil rips
# =============================================================================

is_rip_weak_usd = is_oil_rip and is_valid(dxy_q_ret) and (dxy_q_ret <= 0.0)
is_rip_strong_usd = is_oil_rip and is_valid(dxy_q_ret) and (dxy_q_ret > 0.0)

# =============================================================================
# FX RETURNS (inverted: positive = EM currency appreciated vs USD)
# =============================================================================

# Rolling 63-bar FX return, inverted
fx_q_ret_raw = (close_fx - (close_fx >> 63)) / (close_fx >> 63)
fx_q_ret = -1.0 * fx_q_ret_raw

# Event-filtered returns
rip_fx_ret = where(is_oil_rip, fx_q_ret)
non_rip_fx_ret = where(is_non_rip, fx_q_ret)

# Hit rate: did EM FX strengthen in oil-rip quarter?
rip_fx_hit = where(is_oil_rip, 1.0 if fx_q_ret > 0 else 0.0)

# Oil return during rip events (for event markers)
rip_oil_ret = where(is_oil_rip, oil_q_ret)

# DXY return during rip events (for event markers)
rip_dxy_ret = where(is_oil_rip, dxy_q_ret)

# =============================================================================
# DXY REGIME-FILTERED FX RETURNS
# =============================================================================

# FX returns during weak-USD oil rips
weak_usd_fx_ret = where(is_rip_weak_usd, fx_q_ret)
weak_usd_fx_hit = where(is_rip_weak_usd, 1.0 if fx_q_ret > 0 else 0.0)
weak_usd_count = 1.0 if is_rip_weak_usd else 0.0

# FX returns during strong-USD oil rips
strong_usd_fx_ret = where(is_rip_strong_usd, fx_q_ret)
strong_usd_fx_hit = where(is_rip_strong_usd, 1.0 if fx_q_ret > 0 else 0.0)
strong_usd_count = 1.0 if is_rip_strong_usd else 0.0

# =============================================================================
# EVENT COUNTS
# =============================================================================

rip_count = 1.0 if is_oil_rip else 0.0
non_rip_count = 1.0 if is_non_rip else 0.0

# =============================================================================
# CUMULATIVE EVENT RETURNS (compound oil-rip day FX return across events)
# =============================================================================

rip_event_fx = fx_q_ret if is_oil_rip else 0.0
cum_rip_fx = cumulative()(rip_event_fx)

# =============================================================================
# REPORTS
# =============================================================================

# --- 1. Cross-Sectional Summary Table ---
cs_summary_table(
    title='Oil Rip Event Statistics by Currency (WTI +10%+ Threshold)',
    category='Oil Rip Impact',
    agg=AggregationType.Mean,
    schema=TableReportSchema(
        title='Oil Rip Event Statistics',
        include_timestamp=False,
        columns=[
            ColumnSpec(title='Oil Rip Events', type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat, grid_agg=AggregationType.Sum),
            ColumnSpec(title='Avg FX Return (Rip)', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean),
            ColumnSpec(title='Avg FX Return (Non-Rip)', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean),
            ColumnSpec(title='Hit Rate (FX Strengthened)', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean)
        ]
    ),
    order=0
)(rip_count, rip_fx_ret, non_rip_fx_ret, rip_fx_hit)

# --- 2. Bar Chart: Avg FX Return in Oil-Rip vs Non-Rip Quarters ---
cs_bars(
    title='EM FX Strengthens More When Oil Surges 10%+',
    category='Oil Rip Impact',
    agg=AggregationType.Mean,
    data_labels=True,
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    y_axis_label='Avg Quarterly FX Return vs USD',
    color_by_value=False,
    series_names=['Oil Rip Quarters (10%+)', 'Non-Rip Quarters'],
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    order=1
)(rip_fx_ret, non_rip_fx_ret)

# --- 3. Cumulative FX Return During Oil Rip Events (per asset line) ---
cs_lines(
    title='Cumulative FX Gain from Oil Rip Events',
    category='Oil Rip Impact',
    y_axis_label='Cumulative FX Return',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.PercentFormat,
    order=2
)(bar_idx, cum_rip_fx)

# --- 4. DXY Regime Summary Table ---
cs_summary_table(
    title='Oil Rip FX Impact by Dollar Regime',
    category='DXY Regime Split',
    agg=AggregationType.Mean,
    schema=TableReportSchema(
        title='DXY Regime Comparison',
        include_timestamp=False,
        columns=[
            ColumnSpec(title='Weak-USD Rip Events', type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat, grid_agg=AggregationType.Sum),
            ColumnSpec(title='Avg FX Ret (Weak USD)', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean),
            ColumnSpec(title='Hit Rate (Weak USD)', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean),
            ColumnSpec(title='Strong-USD Rip Events', type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat, grid_agg=AggregationType.Sum),
            ColumnSpec(title='Avg FX Ret (Strong USD)', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean),
            ColumnSpec(title='Hit Rate (Strong USD)', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean)
        ]
    ),
    order=3
)(weak_usd_count, weak_usd_fx_ret, weak_usd_fx_hit, strong_usd_count, strong_usd_fx_ret, strong_usd_fx_hit)

# --- 5. Bar Chart: FX Return by DXY Regime (Weak-USD Rip vs Strong-USD Rip vs Non-Rip) ---
cs_bars(
    title='EM FX Gains Concentrated in Weak-Dollar Oil Rips',
    category='DXY Regime Split',
    agg=AggregationType.Mean,
    data_labels=True,
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    y_axis_label='Avg Quarterly FX Return vs USD',
    color_by_value=False,
    series_names=['Weak-USD Oil Rip', 'Strong-USD Oil Rip', 'Non-Rip Quarters'],
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    order=4
)(weak_usd_fx_ret, strong_usd_fx_ret, non_rip_fx_ret)

# --- Event Markers: Oil Rip Quarters (with DXY context) ---
event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        title='Oil Rip Quarter (WTI +10%)',
        icon=Icon.ZapIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(type=CardRenderType.BooleanFormat, table_is_filter=True),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Hero, title='Oil Quarterly Return', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Details, title='DXY Quarterly Return', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Details, title='FX Return (vs USD)', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2)
        ]
    )
)(is_oil_rip, rip_oil_ret, rip_dxy_ret, rip_fx_ret)
